scope: Causal ASR lifecycle provider and binding evidence. This is not a v12 consumer or action-parity result.

input_contract.accepted_vector_events: events rows OPEN/AUGMENT/REDUCE with bar, ts, price, qty
input_contract.accepted_full_closes: trades rows type=CLOSE with bar_exit, ts, price, qty
input_contract.initial_state: explicit position_exists; held positions also require position_amt, avg_entry_price, entry_ts, opened_ts, entry_bar; optional prior augmentation/reduction/exit fields
input_contract.causality: apply fills only when fill bar < current decision bar; same-bar CLOSE + another event fails closed because separate source lists lack a shared ordinal

lifecycle_provider.consumer_proof: feeds asr_no_double_augment_gate directly in tests; no v12 simulate_one call exists
limitations: gross realized price pnl excludes fees and is not tracker total_realized_pnl
prev_gain_pct is bar-close mark-to-market; native tracker cadence not proven equal
does not reconstruct bounce_reentry_k_reset or DeltaTracker state
initial held position requires an authentic explicit account snapshot
